[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] flew '''a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It could be used in combination with a [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|hyperdrive docking ring]], a device used to achieve faster-than-light travel by starships with no onboard hyperdrive.

==History==
[[File:FistoDelta-7_CloneWars.jpg|thumb|left]]
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Kit Fisto was as comfortable in the vastness of space as he was in the waters of his home planet. Trained since childhood to move and fight in the three-dimensional realm below the surfaces of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm's]] vast oceans, starfighter combat comes as second nature to him. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training has only perfected his skills, while the precise and responsive controls of his ship enhance them even further. His tactics are as graceful as they are deadly, inspiring awe and respect in friend and foe alike.<ref>{{Rebelscum|url=photo.asp?image=/TSC/TSCkitfighterboxbk.jpg|text=Hasbro Target exclusive Kit Fisto's Jedi Starfighter}}</ref> Though he was as skilled a pilot as any in the Jedi Order, Kit Fisto preferred engaging in planetside combat, and took command of Republic forces in many unorthodox campaigns. As a result of his preference and skill, Kit Fisto did fewer performance enhancing modifications to his Delta-7 than many other Jedi. Instead, he strengthened its airframe, struts and landing gear to help it withstand high-speed reentry and rough landings, reasoning that the faster he could get on the ground, the sooner he'd be able to get into the fight.<ref name="Star Wars: Titanium Series">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Titanium Series|pack=Kit Fisto's Jedi Starfighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw07TSkitfistofighter.asp}}</ref> He used a droid called [[R4-H5/Legends|R4-H5]] in this starfighter.
